LESSON: RE-USING WATER

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Caring for the 3.5 Caring for water By the end of the sub-strand, the  Learners
Topic 3.5.2: Re-using water

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Re-using water. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. participate in re-using water to pictures and photographs reduce wastage at home and school

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. participate in re-using water to pictures and photographs reduce wastage at home and school
   In simple words: practise until you can participate in re-using water to pictures and photographs reduce wastage at home and school. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Re-using water using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Re-using water in the examples.
2. Explain Re-using water to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Re-using water.
4. Show that you can: participate in re-using water to pictures and photographs reduce wastage at home and school

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Re-using water using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Re-using water important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Visit the community to find out how water is re-used to reduce wastage.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. participate in re-using water to pictures and photographs reduce wastage at home and school

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
